experiment: v72 frozen v71 repeated 100-case development comparison

protocol.measurement: serial fresh-process ABBA/BAAB, two runs per arm per case, no quality early exit; root equality and native loadouts required
protocol.primaryClassification: Both paired material comparisons <=0 with at least one <0: improvement; both=0: equal; both>=0 with at least one>0: regression; conflicting signs: mixed. Any failed/unverified run: unverified.
protocol.speedMetric: Per-case ratio of arithmetic means across two runs, report all and quality-nondegrading subset separately. Within-arm material quality stability reported separately.
protocol.uncertainty: Descriptive family-cluster bootstrap, fixed seed, 2000 replicates; only 15 development families, selected synthetic distribution, not universal gameplay probability.

uncertainty.description: Descriptive percentile intervals resampling encounter families; synthetic development set, not population confidence guarantees

coreQualitySupplement.method: On copies only, neutralize CombatEndedTurn to 1 for wins and null for defeats; reuse the unchanged C# production comparator. Original quality records and predeclared primary classification are unchanged.

trainingSource: v71 full fit, 292 unique roots; internal validation is now training and not counted as battle tests

verification.localDeployment: Reused successful exact-five-file v71 same-source deployment; no new game binary or model enabled
